notes: Smoother movies on a slow connection: when your provider lists the same film in several qualities (4K, 1080p, HD, SD), the player now uses the lighter copies as quality levels - it opens on one your line can carry and steps down instead of pausing to buffer, stepping back up when the connection recovers. Player controls: the icons at the bottom are smaller, and the name of each control appears above it while the remote is on it.
